//: Every binary file this repository tracks: where it came from, how it is made and under what license. scripts/audit-public.mjs fails on a binary with no entry here, or whose blob or sha256 no longer matches its entry. An entry's "previous" lists the exact bytes (blob and sha256) its path held before, which published commits still carry; history accepts those, the tree only the current ones.
